messages:
Zoe - sales: Quick presales help for NimbusHealth POC. They see streaming stop after ~15s when routing via Azure App Gateway + WAF. Both TS and Python clients show ECONNRESET.

Ethan - solutions: Do we know SDK versions and can they paste a small client log?

Zoe - sales: TS v1.5.0, Py v1.5.0. TS log: `Error: socket hang up
    at TLSSocket.onConnectEnd (node:_tls_wrap:1429:16)`
Python: `ChunkedEncodingError: (\"Connection broken: IncompleteRead(0 bytes read)\",)`.

Vera - eng: Server-side shows continuous output for req-id nh-3f7. No server close. App GW / WAF often has default idle/timeouts or rewrites HTTP/2 behavior.

Miles - infra: Agree. AppGw default idle timeout is 20s and some WAF rules can terminate streams that look like long-lived SSE. Ask customer to test forcing http/1.1 and increasing client keepalive.

Ethan - solutions: Send them these quick tests: 
```
# http2 (likely to reproduce)
curl -v --http2 -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream

# force http1.1 workaround
curl -v --http1.1 --no-keepalive -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream
```
Also `openssl s_client -alpn h2 -connect api.redwood.ai:443` to check ALPN if AppGw rewrites TLS.

Zoe - sales: NimbusHealth tried http1.1 curl and stream stayed open 3+ minutes. AppGw WAF logs show rule that flags long SSE streams and injects `Connection: close`.

Vera - eng: Workaround for POC: set env `REDWOOD_FORCE_HTTP1=1` (TS) or `REDWOOD_HTTP_VERSION=1` (Py) and set `streamingKeepaliveMs` to 45000. Example TS snippet: `process.env.REDWOOD_FORCE_HTTP1='1'; const c = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.KEY, streamingKeepaliveMs: 45000 });`.

Miles - infra: I'll add an infra note to tag long-lived streams with header `x-rw-stream: 1` for easier support lookup and create a KB item about AppGW/WAF heuristics.

Ethan - solutions: Also offer a short Dedicated trial so they can test without AppGw in the path. And provide a one-line security FAQ: "Redwood uses standard TLS 1.2/1.3 from cloud provider stacks; we do not perform custom TLS fingerprinting."

ticket-bot: Created ticket: PRESALES-NIMBUS-389765  add KB: appgw-waf-stream-timeout + support tag x-rw-stream.

Zoe - sales: Sending the workaround + curl tests and offering the Dedicated trial. Will close once Nimbus confirms. :thumbsup:
